asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
mov     [rbp+v1x4], rdi
mov     [rbp+v2x4], rsi
mov     [rbp+results], rdx
mov     rax, [rbp+v1x4]
mov     rcx, [rbp+v2x4]
mov     rdx, [rbp+results]
movups  xmm0, xmmword ptr [rax]
movups  xmm1, xmmword ptr [rax+10h]
movups  xmm2, xmmword ptr [rax+20h]
movups  xmm3, xmmword ptr [rax+30h]
movups  xmm4, xmmword ptr [rcx]
movups  xmm5, xmmword ptr [rcx+10h]
movups  xmm6, xmmword ptr [rcx+20h]
movups  xmm7, xmmword ptr [rcx+30h]
mulps   xmm0, xmm4
mulps   xmm1, xmm5
mulps   xmm2, xmm6
mulps   xmm3, xmm7
movaps  xmm4, xmm0
unpcklps xmm0, xmm1
unpckhps xmm4, xmm1
movaps  xmm1, xmm2
unpcklps xmm2, xmm3
unpckhps xmm1, xmm3
addps   xmm0, xmm4
addps   xmm2, xmm1
movaps  xmm1, xmm0
shufps  xmm0, xmm2, 44h ; 'D'
shufps  xmm1, xmm2, 0EEh
addps   xmm0, xmm1
movups  xmmword ptr [rdx], xmm0
pop     rbp
retn
